title: Window-120 shadow-supervisor evidence accrual

field_principles.schema: A versioned schema lets consumers reject incompatible evidence.
field_principles.experiment: The experiment number binds the artifact to REQ-ARC-WMTE-6776.
field_principles.title: The title states that this is shadow evidence, not a flag activation.
field_principles.run_date: The planning date fixes the frozen run period.
field_principles.status: The status separates ready, partial, disqualified, and blocked outcomes.
field_principles.field_principles: Each required field states why an auditor needs it.
field_principles.inference_substrate: The substrate excludes CPU, remote, legacy, and helper-only runs.
field_principles.duration_s: Monotonic wall time exposes skipped live work.
field_principles.random_seed: The complete cell seed schedule makes action choices repeatable.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: One digest binds models, panel, code, ledger, manifest, and rows.
field_principles.model_specs: Exact repository, file, hash, role, and tokenizer pins prevent substitution.
field_principles.models_used: Only models that produced a live row appear as used.
field_principles.live_model_invoked: First-token evidence distinguishes a live model from a dry receipt.
field_principles.frozen_manifest: Games, seeds, budgets, prompts, sampling, and order are fixed before inference.
field_principles.rows: One cell-and-arm row keeps the full live or blocked denominator visible.
field_principles.gpu_receipts: Lease, offload, VRAM, process, and recovery facts prove owned CUDA work.
field_principles.death_receipts: Signal and process attribution makes an interrupted cell diagnosable.
field_principles.shard_receipts: Atomic block, firing, and completion checkpoints preserve progress.
field_principles.supervisor_window: The value 120 makes a stagnation window reachable within the budget.
field_principles.supervisor_mode: Shadow mode records counterfactuals without applying redirects.
field_principles.action_hash_invariance: Paired action hashes detect any scored behavior change.
field_principles.firings_before_by_arm: The applied ledger baseline prevents shadow inflation.
field_principles.firings_after_by_arm: Post-tool applied counts show exactly what ingestion changed.
field_principles.evidence_floor_met_by_arm: Per-arm booleans state whether ten applied firings exist.
field_principles.supervisor_refinement_receipt: Tool hashes, dedupe, Wilson rows, and recommendation make refinement auditable.
field_principles.shadow_supervisor_transport_ready: Exp6777 consumes this exact transport-and-invariance gate.
field_principles.solve_claim: False prevents a replay receipt from becoming a new solve claim.
field_principles.source_receipts: Hashes and explicit prohibitions show no game source or offline BFS use.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: A blocked or failed result names the exact check and observed value.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Host, route, registry, model, helper, and resource observations remain inspectable.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: False states that transport readiness is not a correctness oracle.
field_principles.verdict_class: A closed class prevents an unsupported result from becoming positive.
field_principles.honest_verdict: A terminal prefix states readiness and evidence limits without inflation.
